mechanism_narrative: When the 3-month moving average of FEDFUNDS exceeds 4%, it predicts a near-term monetary tightening, which raises discount rates and dampens equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during the trigger period (p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS MA(3) never exceeds 4% in the observation window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly employment (PAYEMS) above 132,000 suggests labor market strength, which supports consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative despite PAYEMS > 132000 for at least 30 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 96.2 baseline (as of t-2mo) indicates expanding supply-side capacity, which reduces near-term demand uncertainty and supports positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative when INDPRO crosses above 96.2095, and remain so for 10 consecutive events.

mechanism_narrative: When the 2-month moving average of RSAFS falls below 400,000, it signals contracting supply chains, raising input costs and uncertainty, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite RSAFS MA(2) remaining below 400,000 for 30 consecutive windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPIAUCSL inflation index (below 2%) over 3 months indicates disinflation, lowering policy rate expectations and supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) during the CPIAUCSL < 2.0 window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 7%, it indicates labor market softening, which can reduce growth expectations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite UNRATE < 7.0 for 15 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising consumer demand proxies (HOUST > 700) suggest robust economic momentum, which elevates equity valuation multiples and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive when HOUST remains above 700 for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between falling industrial production (INDPRO) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) below their 2023 averages creates a supply-demand imbalance, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when both INDPRO < 96.2095 and UNRATE > 7.5 for at least 10 consecutive windows.
